award.estimand: Cases in the frozen 28-case set that publish percentage weights and have at least two priced bids. Each such case contributes one rate. Packages inside a case are averaged first.
award.uncertainty: Percentile cluster bootstrap, cases drawn with replacement, 10000 draws, seed 20261123.

mean_reciprocal_rank.definition: Rank is the 1-based TOPSIS group that contains the awarded bidder. Tied bidders share a group.

relative_award_price.definition: (awarded price - unique TOPSIS-top price) / unique TOPSIS-top price. Ties for the top group are omitted.

documents.estimand: Case-equal mean of bid-level mechanical rubric scores. This is the framework arm only.
documents.uncertainty: Percentile cluster bootstrap over cases, 10000 draws, seed 20261123.

checklist_specific_share.definition: Share of the seven R2 checklist items that have specific content.

paired_external_contrast.definition: On one shared tender packet, the mean of framework minus external rubric level, computed separately for R2 and for R3.
paired_external_contrast.reason: The external arm has no document, so the difference is undefined.

consortium.estimand: One pre-specified consortium, scored under preferences fixed from the company files. These are descriptions of that deal, not a sample rate.
